written_from: user prompt only (critic never sees the designer's reasoning or code)
rationale: Part must compile to a valid printable STL.
Part must fit on a standard 256 mm household printer bed.
Must be at least a hand-grippable knob size, not a small cap or disc.
Must not be oversized for a typical stove control knob.
Wall of at least 1.6 mm withstands repeated turning torque in PETG/PLA.
Must have enough material for a grippable body with a shaft socket.
Must not be an excessively solid or oversized block of material.
Must contain at least one complete printable part.
